name: sk-input
description: Text input component for single-line text entry with support for multiple input types, labels, and error states.

variants.name: Default
variants.description: Basic text input with label and placeholder

variants.name: With Hint
variants.example: <sk-input label="Email" hint="We'll never share your email"></sk-input>

variants.name: Disabled
variants.description: Disabled input that cannot be edited

properties.name: value
properties.description: The current value of the input

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder text shown when input is empty

properties.name: hint
properties.description: Helper text shown below the input

properties.name: error
properties.description: Error state; if string, displays error message

events.name: skInput
events.description: Emitted on every keystroke (real-time input event)

events.name: skChange
events.description: Emitted when the input value changes

events.name: skBlur
events.description: Emitted when the input loses focus

events.name: skFocus
events.description: Emitted when the input receives focus

accessibility.keyboard: Supports all standard keyboard interactions for text input (Tab navigation, arrow keys, etc.)
accessibility.screenReader: Fully compatible with screen readers; announces label, hint, error state, and input type
accessibility.focus: Visual focus indicator with color-focus ring

usage.description: Use sk-input for any single-line text entry where users need to provide input. Supports validation through error prop.
dos: Always provide a label for accessibility
Use appropriate type prop for different input needs
Show error messages for validation feedback
Use hint text for helpful context
Disable when async validation is in progress
donts: Don't rely on placeholder alone for labeling
Don't use for multi-line text (use textarea instead)
Don't clear input on blur without user interaction
Don't hide required status in placeholder
